facts.fact: The National Digital Council, 20 experts from the public sector, private enterprises and civil society, was inaugurated on 2 October 2025 by the Prime Minister under the President's directive, with a mandate to advise the government, propose digital-policy recommendations and support implementation of key structural projects under the New Technological Deal; its mandate is advisory.

note: The document calls the strategy a comprehensive plan (universal internet, digital identity, public-service modernisation, sovereign cloud) without saying it covers the economy and the state, so class is left empty.
